nodes.title: Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder (nvfp4, runs on any NVIDIA card)
How to use - tested on RTX 3060
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

1. **Pick a MODE** in Step1. Everything else follows from it:

| Mode | Model | Uses these inputs |
|---|---|---|
| T2V | FL2VA | prompt only |
| I2V (first frame) | FL2VA | First frame |
| Last frame | FL2VA | Last frame (the video ends on it) |
| First + last frame | FL2VA | First frame + Last frame |
| R2V (references) | Ref2VA | Reference 1 + 2 (write `<Picture 1>` / `<Picture 2>` in the prompt) |
| Multiframe | Ref2VA | References + 3 guide frames pinned at their times |
| ControlNet (pose) | Ref2VA + ControlNet | Reference 1 + a control video (pose is extracted) |

2. Write the prompt, set length + size, press **Run**.
3. Only the model your mode needs is loaded (the other branch is skipped).

All nodes are **core ComfyUI 0.37.4** - no custom nodes. Audio comes out of the same run.
Times on the RTX 3060 are in the repo README (measured, not estimated).
